da-r1-f1.rationale: Revision applied at Cross-skill integration `/insights` bullet (concurrency note documenting eventually-consistent read window with consumer-side snapshot recommendation). The producer-skill-documents-the-window approach is surgical and matches the v1 simplicity envelope. v2 deferral to single-write-transaction is conditioned on consumer reports of stale reads — the right calibration for a window the SKILL body cannot eliminate without restructuring Phase F. Cross-cutting concern surface explicitly named; future Phase 3 producer skills (`specflow:decision`, `specflow:scope-change`) should adopt the same documented-window pattern.
